parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The main cylindrical portion of the bottle made of PET plastic, forming the largest volume for liquid storage.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary container for holding liquids, providing structural integrity and volume capacity.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part of the bottle and does not move independently.

parts.name: Body Handle
parts.Basic_description: A small loop-shaped handle attached to the upper body of the bottle, made of PET plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to easily grasp, lift, and pour from the bottle.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the body and does not move, but it is the main contact point for handling.

parts.name: Neck
parts.Basic_description: The tapered section connecting the body to the lid, made of PET plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a narrow passage for pouring and supports the lid or cap for sealing.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structural part that does not move but interfaces with the lid.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A small circular cap made of polypropylene that fits onto the neck of the bottle.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the bottle to prevent leakage and contamination, and can be removed for pouring or refilling.
parts.Movement_description: It can be rotated or lifted off to open and closed by screwing or pressing down.
